rules.title: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections (H.3744)
rules.requirement: Home-rule petition that would authorize the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization. The page gives no operative text, so no cap or formula is stated.
rules.status_basis: Bill history shows it was referred to the Housing committee and then, on 9/9/2024, accompanied a study order (H5035). It was not reported out favorably or enacted.

requires.name: boston_only
requires.text: the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization

coverage.summary: Would apply only in the city of Boston if enacted and implemented.
